# grepr_dataset (Resource)

Manages a Grepr dataset and its backing tables. Table settings made outside Terraform, such as attribute promotion, are left alone. Deleting it drops the tables and is refused while pipelines use it; add `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }` to protect stored data.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "grepr_data_warehouse_integration" "warehouse" {
  name = "terraform_warehouse"
}

resource "grepr_dataset" "logs" {
  name           = "terraform_logs"
  integration_id = grepr_data_warehouse_integration.warehouse.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `integration_id` (String) Managed or S3 warehouse integration ID. Changing it replaces the dataset: the new one starts without the old one's data or table settings, such as its promotion policy.
- `name` (String) Dataset name. Can be updated in place.

### Optional

- `team_ids` (Set of String) Team IDs. Omit to preserve existing teams; use an empty set to clear them.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Dataset ID.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization owning the dataset.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import grepr_dataset.logs DATASET_ID
```
